arxiv-1705-05462.title: CORRELATIONS OF ϵ 𝑲 ′ / ϵ 𝑲 \epsilon^{\prime}_{K}/\epsilon_{K} WITH 𝑲 → 𝝅 ​ 𝝂 ​ 𝝂 ¯ K\to\pi\nu\overline{\nu} IN MODELS OF NEW PHYSICS Presented at the 52th Rencontres de Moriond electroweak interactions and unified theories, La Thuile, Italy, 18-25 March, 2017.
arxiv-1705-05462.creator: T. KITAHARA
arxiv-1705-05462.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by T. KITAHARA. Recent calculations have pointed to a 2.8 σ \sigma tension between data on ϵ K ′ / ϵ K \epsilon^{\prime}_{K}/\epsilon_{K} and the standard-model (SM) prediction. Several new physics (NP) models can explain this discrepancy, and such NP models are likely to predict deviations of ℬ ⁡ ( K → π ​ ν ​ ν ¯ ) \mathcal{B}(K\to\pi\nu\overline{\nu}) from the SM predictions, which can be probed precisely in the near future by NA62 and KOTO experiments.

arxiv-2108-03394.creator: Aladji Babacar Niang, Gane Samb Lo, Moumouni Diallo
arxiv-2108-03394.description: Abstract . arxiv-2209-11799.title: Augmenting Interpretable Models with LLMs during Training
arxiv-2209-11799.creator: Chandan Singh, Armin Askari, Rich Caruana, Jianfeng Gao
arxiv-2209-11799.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Chandan Singh, Armin Askari, Rich Caruana, Jianfeng Gao. Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable prediction performance for a growing array of tasks. However, their proliferation into high-stakes domains (e.g. medicine) and compute-limited settings has created a burgeoning need for interpretability and efficiency. We address this need by proposing Augmented Interpretable Models (Aug-imodels), a framework for leveraging the knowledge learned by LLMs to build extremely efficient and interpretable models.

arxiv-2305-01474.title: A comonad for Grothendieck fibrations
arxiv-2305-01474.creator: Jacopo Emmenegger, Luca Mesiti, Giuseppe Rosolini, Thomas Streicher
arxiv-2305-01474.description: Abstract . We prove that cloven Grothendieck fibrations over a fixed base ℬ \mathpzc{B} are the pseudo-coalgebras for a lax idempotent 2-comonad on 𝒞 ​ 𝒶 ​ 𝓉 / ℬ \mathpzc{Cat}/\mathpzc{B} . We show this via an original observation that the known colax idempotent 2-monad for fibrations over a fixed base has a right 2-adjoint.

arxiv-2309-17011.title: Feature Interaction Aware Automated Data Representation Transformation
arxiv-2309-17011.creator: Ehtesamul Azim, Dongjie Wang, Kunpeng Liu, Wei Zhang, Yanjie Fu
arxiv-2309-17011.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ehtesamul Azim, Dongjie Wang, Kunpeng Liu, Wei Zhang, Yanjie Fu. Creating an effective representation space is crucial for mitigating the curse of dimensionality, enhancing model generalization, addressing data sparsity, and leveraging classical models more effectively. Recent advancements in automated feature engineering (AutoFE) have made significant progress in addressing various challenges associated with representation learning, issues such as heavy reliance on intensive labor and empirical experiences, lack of explainable explicitness, and inflexible feature space reconstruction embedded into downstream tasks.

arxiv-2405-11168.title: A fast and robust discrete FFT-based solver for computational homogenization
arxiv-2405-11168.creator: A. Finel
arxiv-2405-11168.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. Finel. We propose a new discrete FFT-based method for computational homogenization of micromechanics on a regular grid that is simple, fast and robust. The discretization scheme is based on a tetrahedral stencil that displays three crucial properties. First, and most importantly, the Fourier representation of the associated Green operator is defined for any finite q-vector generated by the periodic boundary conditions and that does not belong to the Reciprocal Lattice of the discrete grids.

arxiv-2504-18853.title: Dirac structures in nonholonomic mechanics
arxiv-2504-18853.creator: Katarzyna Grabowska, Michalina Borczyńska, Joanna Majsak, Tomasz Sobczak
arxiv-2504-18853.description: Abstract The concept of a Dirac algebroid, which is a linear almost Dirac structure on a vector bundle, was designed to generate phase equations for mechanical systems with linear nonholonomic constraints. We apply it to systems with magnetic-like or gyroscopic potentials, that were previously described by means of almost Poisson structures.

arxiv-2508-02083.description: Abstract Cyber attacks are unavoidable in networked discrete event systems where the plant and the supervisor communicate with each other via networks. arxiv-2510-03331.title: Intelligent Healthcare Ecosystems: Optimizing the Iron Triangle of Healthcare (Access, Cost, Quality)
arxiv-2510-03331.creator: Vivek Acharya
arxiv-2510-03331.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vivek Acharya. The United States spends more on healthcare than any other nation – nearly 17% of GDP as of the early 2020s – yet struggles with uneven access and outcomes [ 1 ] [ 2 ] . This paradox of high cost, variable quality, and inequitable access is often described by the “Iron Triangle” of healthcare [ 3 ] , which posits that improvements in one dimension (access, cost, or quality) often come at the expense of the others.

pmc-13022807.title: Threshold-Filtered Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulation for Real-Time Simulation and Control of Biomass Fractionation
pmc-13022807.creator: Juhyeon Kim, Jiae Ryu, Qiang Yang, Chang Geun Yoo, Joseph Sang-Il Kwon
pmc-13022807.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). For lignin and other polymer reaction systems, reaction kinetics are inherently complex. Individual bond-cleavage reactions exhibit a wide distribution of activation energies due to structural heterogeneity among β-O-4 linkages. In conventional kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations, reactions with high activation energies, whose probabilities are extremely low, are still evaluated at every step, leading to substantial computational cost with negligible impact on system evolution.
